ComboBox.summary: Drop-down selector: inherits from Button and opens an items list window on click.

props.caption: Current display text; default 'combobox'. Selecting a string item updates it to that item
props.items: Item table {"a","b",...}; string entries become option buttons automatically, pre-built controls are also allowed
props.itemHeight: Height of each item in the drop-down list in pixels (20)
props.selected: Index of the currently selected item; default 1
props.OnOpen: Fired when the drop-down list opens
props.OnClose: Fired when the drop-down list closes
props.OnSelect: Fired when an item is selected by index, with arguments (itemIdx, true)
props.OnSelectName: Fired when an item is selected by name, with arguments (itemName, true)
props.selectionOffsetX: Extra X offset of the drop-down window relative to its computed position, in pixels
props.selectionOffsetY: Extra Y offset of the drop-down window relative to its computed position, in pixels
props.noFont: When true the caption is not drawn; default false

ComboBox:New.desc: Creates the instance and selects the item given by selected so the caption matches it.

ComboBox:Select.desc: Selects an item: numbers by index, strings by name; updates the caption and fires OnSelect/OnSelectName.

ComboBox:_CloseWindow.desc: Disposes the drop-down window, clears labels, fires OnClose and resets the pressed state. (internal)

ComboBox:FocusUpdate.desc: On focus changes: closes the drop-down window when focus was lost and no item is being held down.

ComboBox:MouseDown.desc: Toggles the drop-down: builds a Window+ScrollPanel+StackPanel listing the items when closed, or closes it when open.

ComboBox:MouseUp.desc: Only invalidates and returns self, overriding Button:MouseUp so the pressed state is not changed.

fileDesc: Drop-down selector control: inherits from Button and lists the items in a pop-up Window + ScrollPanel when clicked.
